Company: Springfield Properties

Location: Bengaluru

We are looking for a highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Real Estate Sales Executive to join our growing team. The candidate will be responsible for handling assigned leads, understanding customer requirements, conducting property presentations and site visits, maintaining regular follow-ups, negotiating deals, and ensuring successful closures.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Project Manager

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage the execution of small projects with low complexity. Each day, you will ensure that all related activities are executed in accordance with procedures, regulations, standards, specifications and targets. You will also showcase your skills by defining and applying basic project scheduling techniques to manage schedule risks in advance.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation in Energy Industries in the India Region. Main stakeholders include customers, project sponsors, engineering, procurement, finance, HSE/compliance teams, vendors, and senior leadership, working together to ensure effective project delivery, governance, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Leading the project team allocated to the project, motivating and monitoring internal and external resources.
* Monitoring and controlling project progress, resource utilization, financials, invoicing status, cost, expenses, and cash flow.
* Identifying, qualifying, quantifying, and managing project risks while pursuing all opportunities.
* Ensuring compliance with ABB directives, procedures, cybersecurity regulations, contractual requirements, and HSE policies.
* Securing formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out, and acknowledgment by the customer.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You have 8 to 10 years of experience in Project Management.
* You are proficient in using MS Project and other project management tools to plan, track, and execute projects effectively.
* You have experience delivering projects effectively in a busy business environment.
* You possess effective communication and collaboration skills, enabling you to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* You are highly proficient in SAP and can effectively use it to support project planning, execution, and reporting.

**More about us:**

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Manager, Distributor Promotions & DMO - India
description:
Overview:

**ROLE AT A GLANCE:**

The Manager – Distributor Promotions & DMO Effectiveness is responsible for leading the strategy, development, governance, implementation, and performance management of distributor promotion programs and Daily Methods of Operation (DMO) initiatives across India.

The role serves as the business owner for promotion effectiveness and DMO adoption, driving distributor engagement, activation, retention, productivity, qualification progression, customer acquisition, and sustainable sales growth. The incumbent partners closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to translate commercial priorities into actionable programs that strengthen distributor performance and business outcomes.

This position acts as the primary subject matter expert for distributor promotions and DMO effectiveness, providing strategic recommendations, business insights, governance oversight, and operational leadership to ensure India market objectives are achieved.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Distributor Promotions Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the India distributor promotions strategy and annual promotions roadmap aligned with commercial priorities and business growth objectives.
* Design and implement distributor engagement and recognition programs that drive activation, retention, productivity, customer acquisition, qualification progression, and leadership development.
* Establish promotion frameworks including qualification criteria, reward structures, recognition mechanisms, communication plans, tracking methodologies, and performance success measures.
* Review program effectiveness and recommend modifications to maximize participation, behavioral impact, business performance, and return on investment.
* Provide recommendations on promotion investments, prioritization, and annual planning activities.

**DMO Effectiveness & Field Productivity**

* Serve as the India market owner for DMO effectiveness initiatives and distributor business-building practices.
* Develop and continuously improve DMO frameworks that support distributor productivity, consistency, customer development, and long-term business sustainability.
* Partner with National and Regional Sales Leadership to integrate DMO priorities into field engagement and business development strategies.
* Monitor DMO adoption and effectiveness metrics across regions and recommend interventions to improve execution and performance outcomes.
* Drive best-practice sharing and execution consistency across the market.

**Business Analytics, Insights & Performance Management**

* Establish performance measurement frameworks for promotion and DMO initiatives and ensure alignment to business objectives.
* Analyze distributor productivity, qualification progression, engagement trends, retention indicators, and regional performance metrics to identify growth opportunities and business risks.
* Develop and maintain scorecards, dashboards, trackers, and executive reports that support business decision-making.
* Conduct post-program effectiveness reviews and present strategic recommendations to Sales Leadership.
* Provide actionable insights that influence commercial priorities, field engagement initiatives, and distributor development strategies.

**Governance, Compliance & Operational Excellence**

* Own governance standards and operating processes for distributor promotion and DMO programs across India.
* Ensure programs comply with Herbalife policies, compliance requirements, distributor rules, regulatory guidelines, and internal approval processes.
* Partner with Compliance, Finance, Legal, Associate Services, and Technology teams to ensure effective program controls and risk management practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance process effectiveness, scalability, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead cross-functional collaboration among Sales, Marketing, Distributor Communications, Events, Training, Finance, Compliance, Associate Services, GTS/GSS, and other stakeholders involved in promotion and DMO initiatives.
* Influence stakeholder decisions through data-backed recommendations and market insights.
* Drive alignment, accountability, and execution excellence across functions to ensure desired business outcomes are achieved.
* Act as the central point of coordination and leadership for market-wide promotion and DMO initiatives.

**Innovation & Commercial Growth**

* Monitor market trends, competitor practices, customer engagement models, and distributor incentive approaches to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend innovative program structures, recognition models, and engagement approaches that strengthen distributor experience and business performance.
* Support annual planning discussions through market insights and recommendations related to distributor development and commercial growth priorities.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES**

This role operates as an Individual Contributor but carries significant market-level leadership responsibility through ownership of Promotions and DMO effectiveness across India. The position provides functional leadership and direction across regional sales teams and multiple cross-functional stakeholders and is accountable for influencing execution, adoption, and business outcomes associated with distributor engagement initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, Sales, or related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Excellence, Trade Marketing, Business Analytics, Channel Development, Loyalty Programs, Distributor Engagement, Sales Effectiveness, or related commercial functions.
* Experience working in direct selling, FMCG, retail, financial services, hospitality, insurance, or channel-led business models preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience developing and managing large-scale engagement and incentive programs.
* Ability to influence stakeholders without formal authority.
* Strong project and program management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, Power BI, Excel, CRM platforms, and business analytics applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced business environment.

description:

We are a globally distributed team that thrives on collaboration, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

We value engineers who are constantly evolving how they work — not just what they work on — and who actively seek out better tools, techniques, and approaches to multiply their impact.

As a Senior Analyst, you will analyze telemetry and pipeline metrics, maintain reporting, and assist engineers in tuning data processes. You will contribute to incident reviews by preparing evidence, timelines, and remediation tracking. You will help mature operational processes through data quality, documentation, and automation.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Analyst** on our **Data Engineering** team in **Bangalore.**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

title: Engineering Manager - Agentic AI
description:
**Engineering Manager** **-** **Agentic** **AI**

**Location:** Flexible - remote, hybrid, or based at an Esko location.  
Worldwide locations considered.  
**Function:** Software Engineering  
**Reports to:** Director, Packaging Intelligence

**About the role**

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko.

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable.

**What you will do**

* Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership.

* Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform.

* Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community.

* Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks.

* Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams.

* Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production.

* Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes.

* Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems.

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership.

* Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities.

* Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks.

* A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities.

* Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict.

* Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences.

* Undergraduate, Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines.

**Preferred experience**

* Experience in packaging graphics, prepress, CAD, or the wider graphic arts industry.

* Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities.

* Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems.

**What success looks like**

* Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable – resulting in measurable productivity improvements.

* Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation, rather than “re-inventing the wheel”.

* Providing adequate space for ideation - and inspiration for team members to try new approaches, technologies and techniques.

* Team members are set meaningful, measurable goals - with training and development plans created to facilitate their ongoing personal and career development.

* Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko’s Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices.

* The Agentic AI platform grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.

* A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.
